outcome: Prevalence and risk factors of persistent stress urinary incontinence (SUI) at three months postpartum
cohort: 400 primiparous women without a history of urinary incontinence
finding: Vaginal delivery, particularly instrumental vaginal delivery, BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² at delivery, birth weight ≥ 3360 g, and second stage labor duration ≥ 60 minutes were associated with an increased risk of persistent SUI at three months postpartum.
mod_finding: While vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of SUI, planned or emergency cesarean section without labor did not increase the risk.
